items.title: Run pervypotion.com audience, monetization, health, and backlog baseline
items.summary: Produce a bounded read-only assessment of pervypotion.com using existing authoritative registry, analytics, SEO, revenue-attribution, compliance, operations, social, and AI-usage evidence. Preserve audience, traffic, conversion, revenue, attribution, SEO, health, and cost fields as unknown unless directly evidenced.
items.requested_action: Create a timestamped assessment covering observable audience and content positioning, conversion paths, monetization readiness, health evidence, backlog priorities, measurement boundaries, and explicit unknowns. Acceptance artifact: the completed assessment plus exactly one evidence-backed next action or blocker. Rollback/follow-up boundary: no production rollback is required because no changes are authorized; follow-up is limited to documenting that single next action or blocker. Do not deploy, modify production, change credentials or configuration, request duplicate telemetry, spend money, or claim unavailable outcomes.
